machine_end_gcode:
G91 ;Relative positioning
G0 E-1 Z0.2 F2400 ;Retract and raise Z
G0 X5 Y5 F3000 ;Wipe out
G0 Z5 ;Raise Z more

G90 ;Absolute positioning
G0 X0 Y{print_bed_max[1]} ;pull back
_CLIENT_LINEAR_MOVE E=-10 F=180; retract
M106 S0 ;Turn-off fan
M104 S0 ;Turn-off hotend
M140 S0 ;Turn-off bed

M84
machine_start_gcode:
;Nozzle diameter = [nozzle_diameter]
;Filament type = [filament_type]
;Filament name = [filament_vendor]
;Filament weight = [filament_density]

M220 S100 ;Reset Feedrate
M221 S100 ;Reset Flowrate

M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]; Start heating the bed (without waiting)
M104 S150

G28 ;Home
G90 ; Use absolute positioning
G92 E0 ;Reset Extruder
CLEAR_PAUSE;

M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]; Wait for the bed to reach temperature
M109 S150 ;

AFC_BRUSH
CARTOGRAPHER_TOUCH_HOME ; Home for real Z0
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer];
BED_MESH_CALIBRATE
;M420 S1
SKEW_PROFILE LOAD=default

G0 X5 Y5 Z0.28 F5000.0 ;Move to start position
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]; Wait for the hotend to reach temperature
T[initial_tool]

G1 X5 Y100.0 Z0.28 E8 F800 ;Draw the first line
G1 X5.4 Y100.0 Z0.28 F800;Move to side a little
G1 X5.4 Y5 Z0.28 E16 F800;Draw the second line

G91
G0 Z4.0 F1000 E-.2 ;retract
G90

G92 E0  ;Reset Extruder
